QUOTE: `.yaml`, `.yml`, `.json` | A `path` row per file, zero symbols | Findable by name, but no `memberdef`, so no keys (`steps:`, etc.) enter the symbol namespace.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says YAML/JSON files are in the index as path rows with zero symbols, while shell/CMake get function symbols, so the two file groups are treated differently.
